subject: Re: Air freight quote request – PVG
body:
Dear Alex,

Thank you for the update. The machine parts will be ready for collection on 26 November 2026. Please confirm the earliest collection time and expected arrival at PVG for the fastest available option.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer provides the collection date but also asks for the earliest collection time and expected arrival, which need a response.
